_how: Look at the full image AND zoomed crops (qa.py detail). Mark each item pass/fail/n-a with a short note. Only items you actually looked at count as checked.
common: count and placement of objects as briefed
light direction matches shadows and reflections
no melted, duplicated or random details
no halos or oversharpened edges around subjects
text, logo and symbols exactly right (or absent)

hero: desktop and mobile crops keep the subject (qa.py crops)
